compatibility_decision.2019_2021_vs_2014_2018: Same official table family, KVED 58.21, persons-employed definition, FOP subset and territorial wording. They are method-compatible contextual annual observations under the shared 2014-2021 territory exclusion. Their within-year timing remains unstated; retain the historical no-continuous-trend rule unless the main review intentionally permits this exact source-native segment.
compatibility_decision.2022_2024_vs_pre2022: Same workbook, class and person/FOP fields, but not geography-compatible without qualification. The coverage note changes in 2022 from named occupation exclusions to all Russian-occupied territories plus parts of current/former combat territories. Show a territorial break before 2022; do not portray 2021-2022 as an unqualified national change.
compatibility_decision.vs_ministry_uccr_2021_2024_workers_table: Do not replace or reconcile these totals with the Ministry/UCCR report's 1,015; 1,601; 1,236; 1,025 'workers' values. The directly recovered State Statistics table has a named persons-employed/FOP measure, whereas the later report lacks a matching table-specific definition and cautions about wartime reporting gaps.
compatibility_decision.chart_scope: KVED 58.21 computer-game publishing only. It cannot support a national all-games-development workforce line.
